A3.justification: I support this model's core principles, particularly the fairness safeguards and limited data usage for sensitive traits like nationality or race (which remains 'never acceptable' unless it fixes bias). The conditions on explainability are also reasonable. However, I have reservations about Absalon activity data being set to 'never'; early signs of disengagement often precede academic failure better than grades alone, especially if students hide their struggles behind the screen. Additionally, while blocking discrimination is crucial, we must explicitly rule out using First-Gen status solely for identification (the median requires 1-3 improvement) without clear opt-out mechanisms to prevent labeling. The model works well but only because of these specific design choices ensuring trust.
